en: My master, Plugger Spazzring, is a good boss.  And he makes a lot of money.  His pockets are bursting!

Incredible power can be found in the spirits or "muisek" of the creatures that we battle against.$B$BLook inside yourself; learn to harness the power of your own spirit, and you will be more powerful than you ever imagined.

During the War of the Ancients, the demigod Agamaggan came forth to battle the Burning Legion. The colossal boar was defeated, and over time in the areas where his blood fell, massive thorn-ridden vines sprouted to life. The quilboar came to occupy these regions and hold them sacred. The heart of these massive thorn-colonies is the Razorfen. Razorfen Kraul was conquered by the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who some speculate has been negotiating with agents of the Scourge for some insidious purpose.
Am I carrying any letters addressed to $n? Why, no!  Looks like it's time for you to die!
Your path is steady, $n, for Washte Pawne's resolve is with you.
%s nods.
There! Job's done.
Phalanx, I think you need to teach thos person a lesson.
The All Seeing Eye must be recovered!
Alright, let's go.
Hear ye, hear ye! I'll pause to sell my wares for only a short time here in Lakeshire. Come to the town hall with haste!

You have nearly reached the pinnacle of your training. To become the greatest enchanter you can possibly be, you have one more instructor to seek out. Her name is Annora, and you may find her in Uldaman.
Nagmara!  Have any mutton left?
Last I knew, Elder Stonespire was at Everlook in Winterspring.
%s loses its link!
%s removes the seeds from the Glowing Fruit...

After the fall of Karazhan, the Kirin Tor dispatched an assembly of mages to search the tower and seize all items of import... for the purposes of "research." It was then that the fabled staff was discovered and brought back to Dalaran.
I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!
Have a taste of Frostmane magics.
Now how am I supposed to get those mechanical wretches out of my fields?
You have done well, traveler. I am proud to call you my student!
%s begs Impsy for forgiveness.
Killing you and your cohorts, $c, will amuse me.  I shall make it quick.
Help us, outsider. <The relic crumbles to dust. A vision of eight Dark Iron dwarves performing some sort of ritual fills your head.>
Now I have what is required. Let us continue.
Honored
Raaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaar!!! Me smash $R!
Sure ye don't want to be a Blacksmith?  Well, if yer heart is set on Leatherworking, then you best talk to Fimble Finespindle over at his shop on the northwest side of The Great Forge.
Anathera... I cannot bear to face the rest of eternity without you by my side... If you are taken from me, then let this be the day I also return to the earth...
<Copy the pattern into my journal.>.
You make perfect little hat, $r!
Where is the Auction House?  Why it's right by the gates of Ironforge as you enter our fine city.  Ye'll find it just across from The Vault.
My daddy can catch more fish than your daddy!
That's odd.
Yo, what do you need?
The things I have done... such horrible things...$B$B<Tarsis begins to sob.>

All of the food and war materiel we gathered is on its way to Silithus. It should be there in less than a day. Someone told me that once it's all assembled over near Cenarion Hold, someone's going to have to go ring the gong at the Scarab Dais to open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj and start the war.
If you're going to be taking up my time, you'd better prove you're worth it. I ought to get something out of this arrangement, after all.
What happened to her after that?
Bah! That's no fun!
It was a simple mistake. A wrong turn I tell you!
I think I have heard of this magic.
I'm sorry but I can not let you ride my gryphons. You should go talk to Gringer if you need a ride somewhere.
%s flees after seeing Kel'Thuzad fall!
I have just the spot for this horn!

I do not like these human cities of stone and steel. I would prefer the forests of Ashenvale, tracking great beasts. But my dear brother, Kaerbrus, felt it would be beneficial to train the humans in our ways. So while I honor him and offer my services, I do not have to like it.

Didn't we just break free of the Burning Legion, and here you are messing with demons again?  Seek out the Darkfire Enclave in the underground cavern known as the Cleft of Shadow.  You'll find a tunnel down into it from The Drag.
You think you have what it takes to destroy The League of Arathor, $c?  I hope so.  What is it that you want, or are you simply here to waste my time?
Perhaps a bit more grease will do the trick.
